owners: Each application/API owns its route, settings, and telemetry boundary; the approved footer API remains under apps/api, versioned settings remain the persistence owner, and the current goal is the coordination parent.
invariants: Preserve explicit external/internal isolation, stable IDs and release/assembly/provenance contracts, existing ClickHouse history, and no-production-write policy.
compatBoundary: Footer response and old setting keys remain compatible; ClickHouse search/component/Web Vitals collection and historical records remain while GoatCounter replaces only public pageview analytics; existing routes and API contracts are additive unless separately approved.
nonGoals: No production writes, no silent data/telemetry deletion, no desktop runtime in this monorepo, and no implementation outside a separately approved slice.
